data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this well-designed studio apartment in Carson B, DAMAC Hills.

Offering 412 sq. ft. of efficiently planned living space, this contemporary studio combines comfort, functionality, and modern finishes. The bright open-plan layout is complemented by large windows that allow plenty of natural light, creating a spacious and welcoming atmosphere.

Ideal for both end-users and investors, the apartment features a modern kitchen, a stylish bathroom, and built-in wardrobes, making it a practical choice in one of Dubai's most popular golf communities.
